patch.role: Leg 1: decides whether the monospaced italic reset is needed.
Leg 2: materialises the reset token selected by leg 1.
Leg 3: prepends the reset only when it is needed and not already present.

inputs.control_bold_mono: bold-only style; A is not executed

rationale: The reset is reconstructed by three legs: a predicate, the token value, and the guarded prepend.  Dropping any one leg breaks equality on mask_italic_mono; only the full triple restores P+.  The triple is declared for monospaced output, so expose_italic_nonmono exposes the deletion.
